researchNotes: Values from the Sustainability Statement in the Annual Report and Accounts 2025, read from the ESEF filing because unilever.com returned HTTP 403. 2025 metrics exclude Ice Cream (demerged 6 Dec 2025); 2024 comparatives include it, so only 2025 is recorded.

sources.title: Annual Report and Accounts 2025 – Sustainability Statement (ESEF filing)
sources.notes: Official ESEF XHTML filing hosted on filings.xbrl.org (unilever.com PDF returned 403). Citations use the printed page numbers shown in the filing.

metrics.note: Excludes Ice Cream (0.09 Mt Scope 1+2 shown separately).
Derived: Scope 3 in scope of net zero ambition (47.21) + Scope 3 indirect consumer use (49.34). Consistent with total Scope 1-3 market-based 97.04 minus Scope 1+2 0.49.

Derived: use of sold products – HFC propellants (direct, 1.58) + indirect consumer use (49.34, e.g. heating water for shampoo). Indirect use-phase is optional under the GHG Protocol and excluded from Unilever's net zero scope.
Reported in thousands MWh. Excludes Ice Cream (1,227) and collaborative manufacturers.
63 percentage points come from unbundled RECs.
Only water consumption is tabulated; withdrawal volume is not reported.
Derived: hazardous (19) + non-hazardous (467) diverted from disposal ÷ total generated (493) thousand tonnes = 98.6%. Includes 'other recovery operations'.

metrics.reportedWording: In 2025, we exceeded 95% purchase volumes of palm oil, paper and board, tea, soy and cocoa as deforestation-free
metrics.note: Only a threshold is given, not an exact share; stored as text.

metrics.reportedWording: 100% of our plastic packaging to be reusable, recyclable or compostable(b) | 100% | 57% | 57% | 53%

metrics.note: Only the % change vs 2019 is reported ((29)%), not tonnes.

targets.description: Reduce absolute operational GHG emissions (Scope 1 and 2) by 100% by 2030 from a 2015 baseline; interim 80–90% by 2028.
targets.note: 'Scope 1 and 2 GHG target is SBTi validated.' Target not yet adjusted for the Ice Cream demerger.

targets.description: Reduce virgin plastic footprint by 30% by 2026 and 40% by 2028 from a 2019 baseline.

dataGaps.description: 2024 comparatives include Ice Cream; 2025 excludes it. No 2024 values recorded to avoid a false trend.
Scope 3 categories 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 9 and 14 are reported only as a combined 'Others' line (2.12 Mt).

comparabilityNotes: Unilever's Scope 3 includes 49.34 Mt of indirect consumer-use emissions (optional under the GHG Protocol). Peers that exclude indirect use will look much smaller.
Renewable electricity share relies mostly on unbundled RECs (63 of 88 percentage points).
